watches.name: BI COMPAX Black
watches.description: The new Bi Compax Dual collection is inspired by the chronographs of the 1950s, combining refined design and robustness. Equipped with the Landeron L70M manual movement with 48-hour power reserve, this watch offers optimal legibility thanks to Super-LumiNova numerals. Available with a 38.9 mm polished stainless steel case, and two bracelet options, this individually numbered timepiece is a true ode to traditional watchmaking.

watches.name: EP 884-SI 01
watches.description: The reference 884-SI pays homage to the birthplace of the brand, the village of St-Imier, founded in 884 A.D. and symbolized by the initiales "SI". Inspired by one of the rare three-hands models produced by Excelsior Park in the 1950s, we felt it essential to honor the brand's heritage. Therefore we chose a manual-winding movement, the L21 caliber from Landeron. This watch represents a subtle blend of vintage codes with a contemporary touch, capturing the essence of classic watchmaking while meeting modern expectations.

specsRaw.Dial: Light Ivory , enamel finishing, nickel polished appliedBlue hands
specsRaw.Movement: Mechanical handwinding Landeron Caliber L21, 40 hours power reserve

watches.name: Out of the Park - A collaboration with seconde/seconde/
watches.description: "Excelsior Park is a brand that is dear to me because the very first modified watch I sold was a Zenith chronograph from the 1950s with the famous Excelsior Park 4 calibre. Indeed, seconde/seconde/, whose real name is Romaric André, is a French artist who has built his international reputation on hijacking watches, whether vintage or modern. "When Excelsior Park approached me with this collaboration, I found my angle of attack by translating "Excelsior" which in Latin means "higher,"...Going higher than the 'Park. This led me to the notion of the "home run", the ultimate shot in baseball, of which the expression "Out Of The Park" is a synonym. Unfolding with lightness the imagery of this sport commonly called "America's favourite pastime", the artist does not forget to suggest certain drifts and pronounced inclinations towards anabolic drugs in the early 2000s. "Evoking baseball and its obsessive drive to outperform is a way for me to meet the brand's demands for me to "boost" their chronograph. I wanted to put it literally on steroids.

specsRaw.Movement: Sellita SW 510 M BH B / Mechanical Handwinding
